title: Tesla offers his work to Soviet and German sources

tellings.quote: But there's also, you know, stories about about Tesla also shopping some of his uh work and beliefs with Russian sources or Soviet sources with uh and with the Germans.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla is said to have offered some of his work and ideas to the Soviets and to the Germans. Kurt McConnell, a former Senate staffer, mentions this on the show as "stories" he has heard, without naming where they come from. If true, some of Tesla's inventions might have gone to foreign powers as well as to the United States.
